references.text: Here the sons of Kohath are mentioned: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel, who are the ancestors of the four clans listed in Numbers 3:27.
A later listing of the Levitical families, including the Kohathites and their subgroups.
The children of Amram are mentioned here: Aaron, Moses and Miriam, showing the significance of the Amramites among the Kohathites.
The sons of Kohath are listed: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel, identical to the clans in Numbers 3:27.
The sons of Kohath are mentioned again in connection with David's organization of the Levites.
An earlier reference in the same chapter that mentions the sons of Kohath by name.
The counting of the Kohathite families in connection with their service at the tabernacle.
